Detail of the scattering calculation that renders air on Earth,
Venus, Mars and Titan. Reduced integrates each view ray at
fewer points: no visible change beyond a slight shift in the
thin band at the limb. Minimum estimates each ray in closed form:
surfaces are unchanged, but the limb and twilight shift,
most of all around a crescent. Off draws no air beyond a
body's edge and a simpler haze over its surface.

GPU cost: HIGH at Normal, close to a body with air. Reduced
saves little on integrated graphics; Minimum saves up to half
and Off up to five sixths.

Going into or out of Minimum or Off REQUIRES RESTART.

Maximum number of frames drawn per second. A cap saves
power, heat and battery life whenever the GPU could draw
faster, at some cost to smooth motion. It changes nothing

the display refreshes.
